changes.replacement: Save writes native output and binds a path only after success; Save(stream) leaves association and stream ownership intact. ToBytes returns native bytes. SaveCopy remains the non-rebinding operation.
changes.reason: Persistence and byte serialization have distinct names; PDF and Visio already implement this contract.

changes.new: OfficeIMO.Xps.XpsLoadOptions.Limits (XpsReadLimits: MaxInputBytes, MaxExpandedBytes, MaxPartBytes, MaxParts, MaxPages, MaxDepth)
changes.reason: Load and parse budgets use one Max vocabulary and sit under a discoverable Limits object.
Lifecycle options are named {Format}LoadOptions and {Format}SaveOptions; ReaderOptions is reserved for forward-only readers.
Add methods return the visual actually created.
changes.replacement: Retain the page variable for sibling additions. The returned handle exposes Page, GetMarkup and validated ReplaceMarkup. Path/Glyphs/image-brush XML and resource checks stay native. Page-wide ReplaceMarkup invalidates previous visual handles; a visual replacement preserves sibling handles.
